# Plan — brief.json generated by script (#178)

Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-brief-json-generated-by-script-design.md`

All work is in the `factory` layer (owner agent: `engineer`). Tasks run in order; they share the worktree.

## Task 1 — `brief` command (layer: factory)
Files: `scripts/shipfloor_core/brief.py` (new), `scripts/brief.sh` (new, thin wrapper like `review-page.sh`), `scripts/sf.py` (command `brief`).
- `build <n> --column "Spec Review"|Staged --spec <spec> --head <sha> --notes <file> [--since <json>] [--out <file>]`.
- Output `<reviews>/<n>.brief.json`, written atomically, with `card, column, built, verdict, what, flags, since_request, proven, facts, rest`.
- Flags (script-only): `migration`, `outside-architecture`, `qa-amended`, `open-question`, `security`, `infra-retry`; `verdict` = `look` iff flags or `since_request`.
- Notes: only `what` (cut at 280) and `suggestions` (cut at 120, unknown flag ids dropped) are read.
- Any internal error: one `brief: skipped: <reason>` line on stderr, exit 0.
- Acceptance tests: `scripts/test/brief.test.sh` (written by QA first; do not edit).

## Task 2 — skills and contract doc (layer: factory)
Files: `skills/refine/SKILL.md` (step 6), `skills/validate/SKILL.md` (step 4), `docs/contracts.md` (`## brief.sh` section + `brief.json` row in the files table), `docs/how-it-works.md` only if the contracts-doc test requires.
- Skills: write `<tmp>/brief-notes.json`, run `brief.sh build` before the move; a failure is a log line, never a block.
- Depends on task 1 (the CLI's final form).
